task: Outlook.com or Outlook on the web (the person's own account): export all contacts as a CSV with Outlook's own Export contacts feature, so the bot can seed the BehalfBot CRM. No scraping

steps.human: Sign in to your Outlook account. For a work or school account, go to outlook.office.com/people instead. Press Done when you see the People page.

steps.do: On the toolbar choose Manage contacts > Export contacts, then All contacts. Do not press Export.

steps.human: Press Export yourself, then Done. A contacts.csv lands in your Downloads folder.

accept: contacts.csv is in the person's Downloads. They send it to the bot, which runs chassis/scripts/crm_import.py on it, dry run first.
notes: Only the People page: never open Mail, Calendar or a contact's detail pane.
Sign-in runs on login.live.com or login.microsoftonline.com, which are off the allow list, so the extension lets go of the tab while the person signs in.

Labels checked against Microsoft's 'Export contacts from Outlook.com or Outlook on the web' article on 2026-11-20. Desktop Outlook for Windows has its own File > Open & Export path, documented in chassis/skills/crm-contact-import.md.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential.
